post_clip.description: Two individuals are engaged in a physical altercation at the doorway: one person (in dark clothing, hood up) aggressively grabs and pushes the other (wearing dark jacket and pants), who resists and appears to be struck or shoved repeatedly. The interaction involves mutual physical contact, aggressive postures, and forceful movement consistent with fighting—specifically, mutual combat where both parties are actively involved in the struggle, including grappling and shoving near the open door.

A man in dark clothing is seen repeatedly bending over and striking the lower part of a glass door frame or threshold with his hands/arms (frames 3–5), suggesting deliberate forceful impact—possibly attempting to break or disable the door mechanism. This behavior is inconsistent with normal entry/exit and indicates potential forced entry (burglary/vandalism). No second person is visible, so it is not mutual combat, but the action constitutes suspicious criminal activity.
